I have all the data I need. Here is the completed research.

## ⚠️ One access limitation first

**AJIO.com blocks this browser entirely** (Akamai "Access Denied" on every URL, including `trends.ajio.com`). I could not browse AJIO's own site. I worked around this by using **Google Shopping (India)**, which returned a live, in-stock AJIO.com listing with its current price. The AJIO *offer* data below is fully verified on GrabOn, CashKaro and CouponDunia.

## Products selected (all verified in the ₹1,500–₹3,000 band)

| Store | Product | Listed price |
|---|---|---|
| Myntra | StyleCast x Revolte Shoulder Straps Maxi Dress | ₹1,749 (MRP ₹3,499) |
| AJIO | SVARAA Women Floral Print Straight Kurta with Pants & Dupatta | ₹1,960 (MRP ₹6,999) |
| M&S India | Pure Cotton Striped Oversized Shirt | ₹2,499 (full price) |

## Ranking — highest to lowest potential saving

**1. AJIO — ₹500 firm, up to ₹637 (25.5%–32.5%)**
- **Offer:** `NEW30` — flat 30% off, **capped at ₹500**. Listed identically on GrabOn and CouponDunia. 30% of ₹1,960 = ₹588, so the ₹500 cap binds.
- **Plus:** CashKaro pays **7% (new user) / 3.5% (existing)** = ₹137 / ₹69. CashKaro's AJIO page explicitly frames coupon + cashback as combinable, so I've counted it — but only as an upper figure.
- **Restrictions:** New users / first purchase only; website only. CouponDunia notes the 30% applies to "select products," so the kurta set may not qualify. A separate 20%-off code needs **min ₹1,999** — this item at ₹1,960 misses it by ₹39.

**2. Marks & Spencer — ₹350 (14%)**
- **Offer:** CashKaro **flat 14% cashback on all orders**, no category exclusion. 14% × ₹2,499 = **₹349.86**.
- **Restrictions:** This is *cashback, not a discount* — you pay ₹2,499 upfront. Tracks in ~36 hrs, confirms in **up to 90 days**. Requires a CashKaro account and click-through. **Not valid on the M&S app** (web only). Free delivery (₹1,499+ threshold) is already met.
- **Note:** GrabOn lists 26 M&S entries but **zero coupon codes** — all are sale links. CouponDunia has 0 coupons and 0 cashback for M&S. The "Up to 50% off Womenswear" deal doesn't apply, as this shirt is full price.

**3. Myntra — ₹300 firm, up to ₹331 (17.2%–18.9%)**
- **Offer:** `MYNTRAEXCLUSIVE` — ₹300 off, bringing it to **₹1,449** (confirmed on Myntra's own product page as "Best Price").
- **Restrictions:** **First purchase only**; GrabOn adds min cart **₹1,699** (this clears it at ₹1,749) and that it's **app-only**.
- **Excluded:** The all-users ₹400-off code needs **min ₹2,499** — doesn't qualify. Bank offers need min ₹3,500 — doesn't qualify. An alternative 30%-off code caps at ₹200, so it's worse.
- **CashKaro pays only 1.80% on Myntra apparel** (₹31) — the advertised "up to 6%" is for Home/Beauty, not clothing. CouponDunia has 0 cashback on Myntra.

## Things worth flagging

- **The ranking is robust** — AJIO leads whether you count coupons alone or coupon-plus-cashback.
- **Two of the three top offers are new-user-only** (AJIO and Myntra). If you already have accounts, AJIO drops to ~₹69 and Myntra to ~₹31, which would make **M&S the clear winner at ₹350** — this is the single biggest swing factor.
- **M&S is the only "no strings" saving** in the sense that it needs no first-time status, but it's also the slowest (up to 90 days) and least certain, since cashback can fail to track.
- I did not stack anything the sources didn't support: CashKaro states coupon+cashback combines for AJIO, so I counted it there; I did not assume it for Myntra, where no such statement appears.

As instructed, I made no purchase, created no account, and entered no payment details.
